newsitem.title: USA: Ages Health, Arbour Elder in deal.
newsitem.headline: Ages Health, Arbour Elder in deal.

text.p: Ages Health Services Inc said it entered an agreement with Universal Health Services Inc's Arbour Elder Services unit under which Arbour would assume Ages' operational management on February 1.
Under the agreement, whose financial terms were not disclosed, Arbour would acquire all of Ages' operating assets.
The acquisition is expected to close in the next few months, Ages said. It is still pending the approval of Ages' stockholders.
Officials from Ages were not immediately available to comment further.
